name: RepoDAG — dependency graph for any repository
description: Draws a repository's code imports, CI pipeline and third-party packages as left-to-right dependency graphs, in your browser.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src https://github.com https://codeload.github.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
